prompt: Create a Python 3.12 application for managing employees. An employee has a name, email address, age and salary. The email must be valid, age must be between 18 and 70, and salary must be positive. Provide CRUD operations using SQLite.

intentions.text: I can create a new employee record with a valid email, age between 18 and 70, and positive salary.
intentions.requires: a name, email address, age (between 18 and 70), and salary (positive)
intentions.observable: A confirmation message or success status indicating the employee was created successfully.

intentions.text: I can retrieve a list of all employees.
intentions.observable: A list of all employees displayed, showing name, email, age, and salary.

intentions.text: I can retrieve a specific employee by their name or email.
intentions.requires: an employee name or email address
intentions.observable: The details of the requested employee (name, email, age, salary) displayed.

intentions.text: I can update an existing employee's name, email, age, or salary.
intentions.requires: an employee name or email, and new values for name, email, age, or salary (with constraints)
intentions.observable: A confirmation message indicating the employee was updated successfully.

intentions.text: I can delete an employee record by name or email.
intentions.requires: an employee name or email address
intentions.observable: A confirmation message indicating the employee was deleted successfully.
